title: Vampire Vape Tropical Pineapple Dream 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pineapple Dream Nic Salt from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection offers a gentle escape into tropical flavour, pairing the soft, creamy taste of Pawpaw with the bright tang of Pineapple. Pawpaw brings a smooth, custard-like sweetness with hints of Banana, Mango and Melon, while Pineapple adds a juicy, gently tart top note that keeps the blend light and sunny. The result is a balanced vape that’s mellow yet vibrant, ideal for all-day vaping. Formulated with nicotine salts for fast absorption and a smooth inhale, this e-liquid is perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) kits including pod systems and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths. Vampire Vape e-liquids are crafted in the UK and known for their bold, consistent flavours. The Tropical collection brings exotic flavour pairings to their award-winning range. Also available in Freebase, Shortfill and Concentrate formats.
